name: chat-card
title: Chat Card
description: The chat's one card surface and its parts: ChatCard for what a person acts on or opens, ChatRow for one line of work, ChatGroup for a fold of work that opens and closes smoothly.

meta.whenToUse: A waiting request, question or plan, the task list or a file preview (ChatCard); a line of work with its verb, subject, meta and duration (ChatRow); a fold of work behind one summary line (ChatGroup).
meta.whenNotToUse: Settled work, memory saves, answered asks and errors, which are flat lines in the column; a record or settings card outside a chat (Card).
